messages.text: BL-2061 🎵 in progress — An update the cursor bridge reads for the front desk is never dropped: while the bridge's dead-feeder fallback holds getUpdates it answers and drops every update it has no route for - an Approve or Reject tap, an approve verb typed in the Approvals topic - so the front desk never sees it; QA's hotfixes c416adc5fb and 4453766c28 narrowed that to real front-desk outages, this closes it
